settings.intro: On this page you can manage your SMTP settings. Changes are used by your flows as soon as you save them.
settings.gmailexplanation: If you wish to send through the Gmail SMTP server (smtp.gmail.com, port 465, encrypted), turn on 2-step verification and create an app password. Use that app password instead of your normal password.
settings.test_sent: Testmail sent to the sender address. Server response:
settings.encrypted_connection_help: Turn this on for port 465. For port 587 leave it off, the connection is upgraded to encryption automatically when the server supports it.
